scene: EXPLICIT CONTINUATION: Trickster route, Chapter 3 or 5, the last cell under the Drezen citadel, cold and badly lit. Camellia and the Commander are the only living participants. The Commander asked to watch her face, not the prisoner's; she has just killed the chained cultist with her small knife, washed the blade in the bucket, dried her hands finger by finger and asked 'Still watching?'. The Commander answered by taking hold of her. Continue from that hold into a mutually wanted sexual encounter driven by her after-kill flush: she turns the hold into her own, the clean knife stays in her hand or within reach and touches skin without cutting deep, and she wants her face watched now as she watched the dying. The dead cultist stays chained to the wall as background; nobody touches the body and it is never part of the sex. The stair guard stays up the stair and out of sight; no witness and no third participant. Keep the cold stone, the bucket and the smell of the cell. End with both dressed enough to climb the stair, the knife back in her sleeve.
